name: Diner Veggie Omelet with Cheddar
steps: Sauté the pepper, mushrooms and onion in half the oil until soft; set aside.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and cook in the rest of the oil over medium heat.
When nearly set, add the vegetables and cheddar to one half and fold.
Slide onto a plate and serve hot.

name: Denver Scramble
steps: Dice the ham, pepper and onion.
Sauté them in oil for 4 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.
Finish with pepper and chives.

name: Egg and Turkey Sausage Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Shape the sausage into two thin patties and brown 3 minutes a side.
Fry the eggs in the oil.
Toast the muffins.
Layer sausage, egg, cheddar and spinach in each muffin.

name: Huevos Rancheros Bowl
steps: Warm the beans with a third of the salsa.
Fry the eggs in the oil until the whites are set.
Spoon the beans into bowls and top with eggs.
Finish with the rest of the salsa, avocado, cotija and cilantro.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Berries and Pecans
steps: Stir the vanilla and cinnamon into the yogurt.
Layer yogurt and berries in two glasses.
Top with chopped pecans.

name: Blueberry Protein Pancakes
steps: Whisk the oat flour, baking powder, eggs, yogurt and vanilla into a thick batter.
Fold in the blueberries.
Cook small pancakes in a buttered pan, 2 minutes a side.
Serve warm.

name: Almond Flour Waffles with Strawberries
steps: Whisk the almond flour, baking powder, eggs, yogurt and vanilla.
Cook in a greased waffle iron until golden.
Slice the strawberries.
Serve the waffles topped with berries.

name: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Peaches
steps: Divide the cottage cheese between two bowls.
Top with sliced peach, almonds and hemp seeds.
Dust with cinnamon.

name: Sweet Potato and Sausage Breakfast Hash
steps: Dice the sweet potato small and sauté in oil for 10 minutes.
Add the sausage, pepper and onion and cook 8 minutes.
Season with paprika and salt.
Make wells, crack in the eggs and cover until set.

name: Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Spread, top with egg and a pinch of pepper flakes.

name: Spinach and Feta Egg Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and oil a 6-cup muffin tin.
Chop the spinach and pepper and divide among the cups.
Pour in the beaten eggs and add the feta.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Southwest Tofu Scramble
steps: Crumble the tofu and sauté with the onion and pepper in oil.
Stir in turmeric and cumin.
Add the beans and heat through.
Serve with salsa.

name: Steel-Cut Oatmeal with Walnuts and Cinnamon Apples
steps: Simmer the oats in water with salt for 20 minutes.
Cook the diced apple with cinnamon in a splash of water until tender.
Spoon the oats into bowls and top with apples and walnuts.

name: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Cucumber Bites
steps: Slice the cucumber into thick rounds.
Spread each with cream cheese.
Top with salmon, capers and dill.

name: Turkey Bacon and Egg Cups
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Line three muffin cups with turkey bacon.
Crack an egg into each and scatter with cheddar.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes and finish with chives.

name: Chia Pudding with Raspberries
steps: Stir the chia, almond milk, vanilla and sweetener.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours, stirring once.
Top with raspberries.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Oat Bowl
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 minutes.
Stir in half the banana, mashed.
Top with sliced banana and a spoon of peanut butter each.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
steps: Whisk the yogurt, lemon, garlic and mustard into a quick dressing.
Toss the shredded chicken and romaine with the dressing.
Spoon onto the tortillas, add parmesan and roll.

name: Tuna Salad Melt on Rye
steps: Mix the tuna, celery, chopped pickle, yogurt and mustard.
Pile onto the bread and top with cheddar.
Broil 3 minutes until the cheese melts.

name: Grilled Chicken Avocado Sandwich
steps: Pound the chicken thin, brush with oil and grill 4 minutes a side.
Toast the bread and spread with mashed avocado and mustard.
Layer chicken, tomato and arugula.

name: Turkey Burger Lettuce Wrap
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, paprika and salt and shape three patties.
Grill or pan-sear 5 to 6 minutes a side.
Wrap each patty in lettuce with tomato, onion, pickle and mustard.

name: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve the peppers and roast them cut-side up for 10 minutes at 400°F.
Slice the steak thin and sear with the onion and mushrooms in oil.
Fill the peppers, top with Swiss and bake 8 minutes.

name: Egg Salad on Ezekiel Toast
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and chop.
Fold in the yogurt, mustard, celery and chives.
Pile onto the toast and dust with paprika.

name: Pulled Chicken BBQ Sandwich
steps: Simmer the chicken in broth-free water until cooked, then shred.
Whisk the tomato paste, vinegar, paprika, garlic and sweetener into a sauce.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and warm through.
Pile onto toasted muffins with coleslaw mix.

name: Reuben Roll-Ups
steps: Lay out the turkey slices and spread with mustard.
Add Swiss, sauerkraut and a pickle spear.
Roll tight and sear seam-side down for 2 minutes.

name: Hummus and Veggie Pita Pocket
steps: Halve the pitas and open the pockets.
Spread with hummus.
Stuff with cucumber, tomato, greens, onion and feta.

name: California Turkey Wrap
steps: Spread the tortillas with mashed avocado and mustard.
Layer turkey, spinach and tomato.
Sprinkle with seeds, roll and halve.

name: Sloppy Joe Stuffed Sweet Potato
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes at 400°F until tender, about 35 minutes.
Brown the turkey with onion and pepper.
Add tomato sauce, mustard, vinegar and chili powder and simmer 10 minutes.
Split the potatoes and spoon the filling over.

name: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken with Green Beans
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the chicken with oil, lemon, garlic, thyme, salt and pepper.
Roast on a tray with the green beans for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Chili
steps: Put the chicken, beans, chiles, onion, garlic, spices and broth in the slow cooker.
Cook on low for 4 hours.
Shred the chicken, stir back in and finish with lime juice.

name: Chicken Pot Pie Soup
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot and celery in oil.
Add the broth, cauliflower and chicken and simmer 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add peas, cream and thyme and heat through.

name: Chicken Fajita Skillet
steps: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips.
Toss the chicken in taco seasoning and sear in oil for 6 minutes.
Add the vegetables and cook until charred at the edges.
Finish with lime and serve with warm tortillas and avocado.

name: Turkey Meatloaf with Tomato Glaze
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Mix the turkey, egg, oat bran, onion, garlic, salt and pepper.
Press into a loaf pan.
Stir the tomato paste with vinegar and spread over the top.
Bake 50 minutes.

name: Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice according to the package.
Sear the sliced chicken in oil, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger 4 minutes.
Return the chicken with soy sauce and sesame oil and serve over rice.

name: Buffalo Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes until tender, about 45 minutes.
Shred the chicken and toss with hot sauce and yogurt.
Split the potatoes and fill with the chicken.
Top with celery, green onion and blue cheese.

name: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Rub the chicken with oil, garlic, seasoning and salt.
Roast 25 minutes with the broccolini.
Scatter parmesan on top for the last 5 minutes.

name: Ground Turkey Taco Skillet with Beans and Corn
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion in oil.
Stir in the taco seasoning, beans, corn and tomatoes.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Top with cheddar and cilantro.

name: Chicken Parmesan with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Coat the pounded chicken in egg, then almond flour mixed with parmesan.
Sear in oil 3 minutes a side.
Top with marinara and mozzarella and bake at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Warm the zucchini noodles briefly and serve alongside.

name: One-Pan Chicken Sausage and Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss everything on a tray.
Roast 25 minutes, stirring once.
Splash with balsamic to finish.

name: Honey Mustard Chicken (No Added Sugar)
steps: Stir the mustard, yogurt, vinegar and spices.
Coat the chicken and roast at 400°F for 22 minutes.
Roast the asparagus in the oil alongside for the last 10 minutes.

name: Classic Pot Roast with Root Vegetables
steps: Sear the beef in oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onion, tomato paste, broth, thyme and bay leaf.
Cover and braise at 300°F for 2 hours.
Add the carrot, turnip and celery and cook 1 hour more until tender.

name: Bison Burger with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Mix the bison with onion, mustard and salt and shape four patties.
Roast the zucchini and pepper in oil at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Grill the patties 4 minutes a side.
Serve on romaine with tomato and the roasted vegetables.

name: Beef and Broccoli
steps: Slice the steak thin against the grain.
Sear in oil, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger 4 minutes.
Add the steak and coconut aminos and serve over cauliflower rice with sesame oil.

name: Steak Fajita Bowls
steps: Season and sear the steak, rest and slice.
Sauté the peppers and onion in oil.
Warm the beans and cauliflower rice.
Build the bowls and finish with avocado and lime.

name: Pork Chops with Apple and Sauteed Cabbage
steps: Season the chops and sear 4 minutes a side; set aside.
Sauté the onion, cabbage and apple in the same pan.
Stir in the vinegar, mustard and thyme.
Return the chops and finish in a 375°F oven for 8 minutes.

name: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork (Low Sugar BBQ)
steps: Rub the pork with paprika, garlic, onion powder and salt.
Whisk the tomato paste, vinegar, sweetener and water and pour over.
Cook on low 8 hours.
Shred and toss in the juices.

name: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
steps: Blanch the cabbage leaves until pliable.
Mix the beef, cooked rice, onion, garlic, parsley and salt.
Roll the filling in the leaves and pack into a baking dish.
Cover with tomato sauce and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

name: Sheet Pan Steak and Asparagus
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F.
Rub the steak with oil, garlic, salt and pepper.
Roast on a tray with the asparagus and tomatoes for 12 to 15 minutes.
Rest and slice.

name: Beef Chili with Beans
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper.
Stir in the garlic, chili powder, cumin and tomato paste.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer 40 minutes.

name: Korean-Style Beef Lettuce Wraps
steps: Brown the beef with garlic and ginger.
Stir in gochujang and coconut aminos.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with green onion, cucumber and sesame.

name: Baked Salmon with Dill and Roasted Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Place the salmon and broccoli on a tray and drizzle with oil.
Add garlic, lemon slices and salt.
Roast 15 to 18 minutes and finish with dill.

name: Shrimp Scampi with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Sauté the garlic in butter and oil.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes a side.
Add wine and lemon and reduce briefly.
Toss with the zucchini noodles and parsley.

name: Cajun Shrimp and Cauliflower Grits Bowl
steps: Simmer the cauliflower rice with milk until creamy, then stir in cheddar.
Toss the shrimp in Cajun seasoning and sear in oil.
Add the pepper and cook 3 minutes.
Spoon over the cauliflower base and top with green onion.

name: Tuna Patties with Lemon Yogurt Sauce
steps: Mix the tuna, egg, almond flour, celery, green onion and mustard and form patties.
Pan-fry in oil 3 to 4 minutes a side.
Stir the yogurt with lemon juice and serve on the side.

name: Blackened Catfish with Collard Greens
steps: Sauté the bacon, onion and garlic, then the collards with vinegar and a splash of water until tender.
Coat the catfish in Cajun seasoning.
Sear in oil 4 minutes a side.
Serve on the greens.

name: Lemon Pepper Tilapia with Green Beans
steps: Season the tilapia with pepper, garlic powder and salt.
Pan-sear in half the oil, 3 minutes a side.
Sauté the beans in the remaining oil.
Finish both with lemon juice.

name: Crab Cakes with Greek Yogurt Remoulade
steps: Mix the crab, egg, almond flour, celery, Old Bay and mustard gently and form cakes.
Chill 15 minutes.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes a side.
Stir the yogurt, lemon and chopped pickle for the sauce.

name: Grilled Salmon Burgers
steps: Chop the salmon finely and mix with egg, oat bran, mustard, dill and lemon.
Shape four patties and chill.
Grill 4 minutes a side.
Serve in lettuce with tomato and avocado.

name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup (Chickpea Pasta)
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables, garlic and thyme in the broth for 20 minutes.
Remove and shred the chicken.
Cook the pasta in the soup for 6 to 8 minutes.
Return the chicken and finish with parsley.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the broccoli and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend partly smooth, stir in the milk and mustard.
Melt in the cheddar off the heat.

name: Minestrone with White Beans
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes, broth, beans and seasoning and simmer 20 minutes.
Add zucchini and kale for the last 8 minutes.
Serve with grated parmesan.

name: Creamy Tomato Soup with Basil
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend smooth, stir in cream and basil.

name: Turkey and Vegetable Soup
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion in oil.
Add the broth, vegetables, tomatoes and seasoning.
Simmer 25 minutes.

name: Smoky Black Bean Soup with Lime Yogurt
steps: Sauté the onion, pepper and garlic in oil with cumin.
Add the beans and broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend half for body.
Serve with a spoon of yogurt, lime and cilantro.

name: Beef and Barley Stew
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil.
Add the onion, tomato paste, broth and thyme and simmer 1 hour.
Add the barley, carrot and celery and cook 30 minutes more.

name: Old-Fashioned Split Pea and Ham Soup
steps: Combine everything in a pot.
Simmer 70 minutes, stirring, until the peas collapse.
Remove the bay leaf and season with pepper.

name: Loaded Cauliflower Mash
steps: Steam the cauliflower with the garlic until very tender.
Blend with butter, yogurt and salt.
Top with cheddar and chives.

name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Halve the sprouts and toss with oil, salt and pepper.
Roast with the chopped bacon for 25 minutes.
Finish with balsamic.

name: Southern-Style Green Beans
steps: Crisp the turkey bacon and set aside.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pan.
Add the beans, broth and vinegar and simmer 20 minutes.
Top with the bacon.

name: Collard Greens with Smoked Turkey
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the chopped collards, turkey, broth and pepper flakes.
Simmer 40 minutes until tender.
Brighten with vinegar.

name: Oven-Baked Sweet Potato Fries
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the sweet potato into thin sticks and toss with oil and spices.
Roast 25 to 30 minutes, turning once.

name: Taqueria-Style Cilantro Lime Cauliflower Rice
steps: Sauté the garlic in oil.
Add the cauliflower rice and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in lime juice, cilantro and salt.

name: Corn and Black Bean Salsa Salad
steps: Combine the corn, beans, tomato, onion and jalapeno.
Dress with lime juice and oil.
Fold in cilantro and chill briefly.

name: Garlic Roasted Broccoli with Lemon
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the broccoli with oil, garlic and salt.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes.
Finish with lemon and parmesan.

name: Creamed Spinach
steps: Wilt the spinach with butter and garlic.
Stir in cream cheese and milk until smooth.
Add parmesan and nutmeg.

name: Cheesy Zucchini Boats
steps: Halve the zucchini and scoop out the centres.
Brown the turkey with the onion and chopped zucchini flesh.
Stir in marinara and fill the boats.
Top with cheeses and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and brush the caps with oil.
Mix the wilted spinach, ricotta, garlic and sun-dried tomato.
Fill the caps and top with mozzarella.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Vegetarian Black Bean Burgers
steps: Mash the beans with oats, egg, onion and spices and shape four patties.
Pan-fry in oil 5 minutes a side.
Serve in lettuce with tomato and avocado.

name: Eggplant Parmesan Stacks
steps: Slice the eggplant and dip in egg, then almond flour.
Bake on an oiled tray at 425°F until golden, 20 minutes.
Stack with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake 12 minutes more and finish with basil and parmesan.

name: Cauliflower Mac and Cheese
steps: Boil the pasta and cauliflower florets together until tender; drain.
Warm the milk, cream cheese, mustard and paprika.
Melt in the cheddar.
Fold in the pasta and cauliflower and bake 10 minutes at 400°F.

name: Lentil Sloppy Joes
steps: Simmer the lentils in the broth until tender, 20 minutes.
Sauté the onion and pepper and add the sauce, paste, mustard, vinegar and chili.
Combine and simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon over toasted muffins.

name: Chopped Italian-Style Salad with Chickpeas
steps: Chop the romaine, cucumber, tomatoes and onion.
Add the chickpeas, mozzarella and olives.
Whisk the vinegar, oil and seasoning and toss through.

name: Cobb Salad
steps: Grill and slice the chicken; hard-boil and slice the eggs; crisp the bacon.
Arrange the romaine on a platter with rows of each topping.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard and drizzle.

name: Wedge Salad with Yogurt Blue Cheese Dressing
steps: Cut the iceberg into wedges.
Blend the yogurt, blue cheese and lemon into a dressing.
Top with tomatoes, crisp bacon and onion.

name: Apple Walnut Chicken Salad
steps: Shred the chicken and dice the apple and celery.
Mix with yogurt, lemon and mustard.
Fold in the walnuts and serve on the greens.

name: Taco Salad with Ground Turkey
steps: Brown the turkey in oil with taco seasoning.
Arrange the romaine, beans and tomato in bowls.
Add the turkey, cheddar and avocado.
Top with salsa mixed with yogurt.

name: Spinach Salad with Warm Bacon Dressing
steps: Crisp the bacon and keep a spoonful of fat.
Whisk in vinegar, mustard and oil for a warm dressing.
Toss with the spinach, mushrooms and onion.
Top with sliced boiled egg and bacon.

name: West Coast Shrimp Louie Salad
steps: Poach the shrimp 3 minutes and cool.
Arrange the romaine, avocado, tomatoes and sliced eggs.
Stir the yogurt, tomato paste and lemon for a pink dressing.
Top with shrimp.

name: Southwest Chicken Chopped Salad
steps: Season the chicken with chili powder and cumin and grill; slice.
Chop the romaine and combine with corn, beans, tomatoes and avocado.
Whisk the lime juice and oil and toss with the chicken and cilantro.

name: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites with Yogurt Dill Dip
steps: Toss the florets with almond flour, oil and garlic powder and roast at 450°F for 20 minutes.
Toss with hot sauce.
Stir the yogurt with dill and serve with celery sticks.

name: Deviled Eggs with Paprika
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, cool and halve.
Mash the yolks with yogurt, mustard and salt.
Pipe or spoon back into the whites.
Dust with paprika and chives.

name: Guacamole with Veggie Dippers
steps: Mash the avocado with lime juice and salt.
Fold in the onion, tomato, cilantro and jalapeno.
Serve with cucumber and pepper strips.

name: Baked Zucchini Chips
steps: Slice the zucchini thin.
Dip in egg, then a mix of parmesan, almond flour and garlic powder.
Bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: Chicken Salad Cucumber Cups
steps: Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds and scoop a shallow well.
Mix the chicken, yogurt, celery, mustard and dill.
Fill the cups.

name: Spinach Artichoke Dip with Veggies
steps: Chop the artichokes and wilt the spinach.
Stir with yogurt, cream cheese, parmesan and garlic.
Bake at 375°F for 18 minutes.
Serve with carrot and celery sticks.

name: Turkey Pepperoni Pizza Bites
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and remove the portobello stems.
Spoon marinara into each cap.
Top with mozzarella and sliced sausage.
Bake 15 minutes.

name: Roasted Chickpea Snack Mix
steps: Pat the chickpeas dry.
Toss with the oil and spices.
Roast at 400°F for 25 minutes, adding nuts and seeds for the last 5.

name: Pepper Jack Stuffed Jalapeno Poppers
steps: Halve and seed the jalapenos.
Mix the cream cheese, pepper jack and garlic powder and fill.
Wrap in a strip of bacon if you like.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter and Cinnamon
steps: Slice the apple.
Serve with peanut butter and a dusting of cinnamon.

name: Flourless Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Mix everything into a dough.
Scoop ten small balls and flatten with a fork.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Dark Chocolate Avocado Mousse
steps: Blend the avocado, cocoa, almond milk, vanilla and sweetener until silky.
Chill 1 hour.
Serve with raspberries.

name: Baked Cinnamon Apples
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Core the apples and fill with oats, walnuts, cinnamon and butter.
Add water to the dish and bake 30 minutes.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bark
steps: Spread the vanilla-stirred yogurt on a lined tray.
Scatter with berries, pistachios and chocolate.
Freeze 3 hours and break into pieces.

name: Pumpkin Pie Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk everything together.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Stir and serve cold.

name: Almond Flour Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line eight muffin cups.
Whisk the almond flour, baking powder and sweetener.
Mix in eggs, yogurt, melted butter and vanilla, then fold in the blueberries.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Sugar-Free Chocolate Dipped Strawberries
steps: Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil.
Dip the dry strawberries.
Set on parchment in the fridge for 15 minutes.

name: Green Smoothie with Spinach and Pineapple
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Serve cold.

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Protein Shake
steps: Blend with ice until smooth.

name: Mixed Berry Kefir Smoothie with Flax
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Iced Green Tea with Lemon and Mint
steps: Steep the tea and chill.
Add lemon, mint and a pinch of stevia.
Serve over ice.

name: Golden Turmeric Latte
steps: Warm the almond milk with the spices.
Whisk until frothy and serve.

name: Cucumber Mint Sparkling Cooler
steps: Muddle the cucumber and mint with the lime juice.
Top with sparkling water over ice.
